name: MeanCache
plain: On skipped steps it uses an estimate of the average velocity over the interval, built from a finite difference of past velocities, instead of repeating the last velocity. With PSSP on (the default) a precomputed skip schedule decides, and a peak limit and accumulated error can veto a skip. The relative threshold gate is used only with PSSP off. Presets are named by quality in the node.
math:
JVP ≈ (v_t − v_r)/(σ_r−σ_t). û = v_cache + (σ_cache−σ)·JVP.
Runtime deviation: L_K ≈ mean|v_new − (v_cache + dt·JVP)|/mean|v_new|; rel L1 fallback before a JVP exists.
PSSP on: skip_mask from DP, vetoed if deviation>peak_threshold or accumulated>0.8·(0.5+budget/2). PSSP off: should_skip_step with rel_l1_thresh.
K by sigma (get_optimal_k) when adaptive_k.

props.architectures: Node named for Z-Image; flow-matching assumed; no strict class check seen in the grep.

label: from code

audit.note: Skip logic misdescribed. patch/model_patch.py:398-410: with PSSP on (default) the scheduler's skip mask decides and rel_l1_thresh is not consulted; it is used only with PSSP off. core/trajectory_scheduler.py:290-296: peak_threshold and accumulated error veto scheduled skips. The runtime metric is compute_online_L_K (model_patch.py:490), relative prediction error, with rel-L1 only as a fallback before a JVP exists. The L_K formula in the entry is compute_stability_deviation, which the patch does not import.
